# Data Source: identitynow_branding

Use this data source to look up a branding item by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_branding" "default" {
  name = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the branding item, e.g. `default`.

### Read-Only

- `action_button_color` (String) Hex color of action buttons.
- `active_link_color` (String) Hex color of links.
- `email_from_address` (String) Sender address of emails.
- `id` (String) Name of the branding item.
- `login_informational_message` (String) Informational message shown on the login page.
- `navigation_color` (String) Hex color of the navigation bar.
- `product_name` (String) Product name.
- `standard_logo_url` (String) URL of the standard logo.
